description: Multi-variation A/B pack: 10 copy/image variants (Gemini + Leonardo) while sharing one 12s master video render. Five parallel workers add coordination overhead; one retry on fragile providers; 8% transcode on shared video.

lines.notes: Single hero clip reused across variants — not multiplied by 10

optimal_engine_by_objective.maximize_ctr_testing: gemini_flash_text + leonardo_image for 10-way copy/visual A/B; keep runway_video single shared asset to avoid 10× video cost
optimal_engine_by_objective.minimize_credit_spend: reduce leonardo_image outputs or use static template backgrounds; shorten shared runway_video seconds
optimal_engine_by_objective.faster_wall_clock: parallel.jobs=5 lowers elapsed time; credits include coordination overhead — tune coordinationOverheadPerExtraJob from observability
